Container.Name: PrintStash
Container.Overview: PrintStash is a self-hosted 3D print library and G-code vault. This image runs the web UI and API together. Set the administrator username and password to create the first account at first start, or leave them blank and create it in the browser from your local network. The one appdata path stores everything PrintStash keeps: the database, uploaded files, thumbnails, staging files, backups, and caches. Add existing model folders as separate Library sources after setup; do not use an existing library as the appdata path.

Container.Requires: Fill in the administrator username and password to create the first administrator at first start. If you leave them blank, open the WebUI from your local network (tower.local or the server's LAN IP) to register in the browser; the first person to register becomes administrator. Registration through Tailscale, a VPN, a reverse proxy or a domain is refused, so fill in the fields if you will first connect that way. When moving from the old two-container install, record the old API data owner first, then stop both old containers. Set PUID and PGID to that same owner (the old image usually used 10001:10001); otherwise existing Library sources can become unreadable. Follow the migration guide.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to open PrintStash in your browser.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Dedicated persistent folder for everything PrintStash keeps: database, managed files, thumbnails, staging, backups, and caches. Keep it on one pool and add no second mapping for a subfolder of /data; imports then copy each file instead of using a hard-link. Do not map an existing model library here.

Config.Name: Administrator username
Config.Description: Creates this administrator at first start; sign in with it and choose where files are stored. Fill this in if you will first open PrintStash through Tailscale, a VPN, a reverse proxy or a domain. If left blank, the first administrator can only be created in the browser from your local network (for example http://tower.local:3000 or the server's LAN IP). Used once: it never changes an existing account.

Config.Name: Administrator password
Config.Description: Optional, at least 8 characters, required with the username. Used once: editing it later does not change the account; reset it under Settings, Users instead.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Numeric owner for appdata and mounted Library sources. Default is Unraid's nobody user. On upgrade, use the old API data owner's UID to keep existing Library sources readable.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Numeric group for appdata and mounted Library sources. Default is Unraid's users group. On upgrade, use the old API data owner's GID to keep existing Library sources readable.

Config.Name: First-run setup
Config.Description: Allows the first administrator to register from a trusted local network. Registration closes after the first account is created.

Config.Name: Settings restart
Config.Description: Allows Settings to restart the supervised application container.
